description: Searches the public circuit, firmware and schematic designs people have shared on breadboardhub, such as "ESP32 temperature sensor", "buck converter" or "Arduino motor driver". Returns each design's name, type, tags, stars and link. Free, with no daily limit.

limit.description: How many designs to return, 1 to 10 (default 5).

query.description: Words to search for, such as "esp32 temperature" or "buck converter" (2 to 100 characters).

name: search_designs
title: Search circuit designs
